verdict.rationale: Drata's developer portal says it lets users "automate compliance workflows with custom triggers and actions," which names the rule-trigger-action capability directly. The evidence is a single marketing line, with no documentation of how rules are defined, which events can fire them, or which actions are available. Custom monitoring tests are adjacent (checks, not event-triggered actions), and status-page incident emails are not user-defined automation. Missing for 10: documented rule/trigger configuration, list of supported event types and actions, examples or API endpoints for workflow automation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
